input: Find basketball and volleyball camps (including college coaches and high school camps) for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: 2026 basketball volleyball summer camps Asheville high school
Asheville high school youth basketball volleyball camps summer 2026

candidates.name: UNC Asheville
candidates.note: College-coached boys’ and girls’ basketball camps and volleyball camps; youth and prospect options.

candidates.name: T.C. Roberson High School
candidates.note: 2026 boys’ basketball for rising grades 3–12, girls’ basketball clinic, and volleyball for rising grades 5–9.

candidates.name: Enka High School
candidates.note: Enka Jet Volleyball Camp registration for grades 6–8 on July 29, 2026.

candidates.name: A.C. Reynolds High School
candidates.note: Youth sports camp materials posted for summers 2025 and 2026; individual sport details require checking the flyers.

candidates.name: Hendersonville High School
candidates.note: Bearcat Basketball Camp listed on the school’s athletic camps page; session year and ages are not visible.

candidates.name: Carolina Day School
candidates.note: Co-ed basketball camp for ages 5–13 ran July 6–10, 2026, open to students from any school.

candidates.name: KP Volleyball Training
candidates.note: 2026 summer volleyball camps and beginner clinics covering serving, passing, setting, attacking, and competitive play.

candidates.name: Asheville Sand Volleyball Club
candidates.note: 2026 beach volleyball camps at Highland Brewing for ages 10–17, coached by Marcelo Duarte.

candidates.name: Crossfire Ministry
candidates.note: Announced Monday–Thursday afternoon basketball camps for 2026, with Asheville and Hendersonville anticipated locations.

candidates.name: Brevard College
candidates.note: 2025 basketball camps and a June 13, 2026 volleyball prospect camp for grades 9–12.

candidates.name: PGC Basketball
candidates.note: 2026 Scoring College overnight basketball camp at Mars Hill University for incoming grades 9–12.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: Nike Boys Basketball Camp at Warren Wilson College for ages 8–16 listed among local summer offerings.

candidates.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 multisport summer programming at Burton Street Center included basketball and volleyball, rather than single-sport camps.
